_comment: Class test sets of rule `test-sets` (brief_lint.py, mistake #25), bound to this repository. A feature, code or review brief names every entry of `required` and every entry of at least one group of `alternatives`, or carries `Test sets: not applicable: <reason>`. Each entry is a label (shown when missing) and a case-insensitive regular expression over the brief text; the patterns match suite paths and fixed test names, not free language. Validated by brief_lint.load_class_sets.

required.label: the property tests of parsers and validators (docs/test-plan.md, Property)
